name: Last One Standing: Royal Massacre
source:
“Last One Standing: Royal Massacre” is a psychological horror/murder mystery visual novel that explores a different side of the classic no-escape storyline.

After being abducted by a mysterious man who provides no name beyond "the King of the Competition" before ordering them to serve as his Court — the participants in his Royal Competition of Death, a challenge in which they will be forced to murder each other until one remains — fifteen unconnected people must figure out how to not only avoid untimely demise, but uncover the details of their situation and the King's motivation. This proves to be a much more difficult task than anticipated as perspectives clash, rifts form, and caution morphs into secrecy, raising the question of who can safely be trusted within their shared goals.

[From [url=https://crimson-sugar-studio.itch.io/last-one-standing-royal-massacre]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《最后一站：皇家大屠杀》是一部心理恐怖/谋杀悬疑视觉小说，探索了经典的无法逃脱的故事情节的不同侧面。

被一名神秘男子绑架后，这名神秘男子除了“竞赛之王”之外没有提供任何名字，然后命令他们担任他的宫廷——皇家死亡竞赛的参与者，在这项挑战中，他们将被迫互相谋杀，直到只剩下一个——十五个毫无联系的人必须弄清楚如何不仅避免过早死亡，而且还要揭露他们处境的细节和国王的动机。事实证明，这是一项比预期困难得多的任务，因为观点冲突、裂痕形成，谨慎变成了秘密，引发了一个问题：在他们的共同目标中，谁可以安全地被信任。

[来自[url=https://crimson-sugar-studio.itch.io/last-one-standing-royal-massacre]Itch.io[/url]]
